text:
deploy-bot: Starting micro rollout: service=response-api image=redwood/response:v2.4.1 -> 3% traffic in prod-west. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Auto-metrics: latency, 5xx, tok/cost. Ping @mike @eva for stop/go.

mike: seeing. are we pinned to v2.4.1 everywhere or just a route split?

deploy-bot: Route split. Stable remains v2.4.0; canary v2.4.1 at 3%.
eva: thanks. I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards (dash/response-api).
tom: quick heads up — synthetic p99 looks fine but health checks from eu1 show 2 failures in last 5m. small sample.
mari: can you paste the failing logs?
tom: log snippet: ```
2026-03-20T02:12:03Z ERROR handler.go:142 timeout waiting for kv-cache
2026-03-20T02:12:04Z WARN grpc conn reset
```
mike: hmm kv-cache timeout + grpc resets. could be infra noisy. mari, eva — recommend hold at 3% while we validate.
mari: +1 hold. can we throttle downstream retries for the canary route?
eva: I'll flip retry-policy to conservative for canary, doing it now.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @3% (5m window): error_rate +0.9% absolute vs stable, latency p95 +120ms. Alert threshold is +0.5% error.
mike: that's over threshold. calling STOP. pause rollout and pin stable traffic to v2.4.0. set rollout=paused.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Current traffic: stable=97%, canary=3% (paused).
mike: mari — prepare rollback plan, but let's try quick rollback to v2.4.0 for canary path. If rollback fails, we will full rollback.
mari: rollback command: ```/deploy rollback --service response-api --from-version v2.4.1 --to-version v2.4.0 --scope canary``` executing in 10s.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback...
deploy-bot: Rollback applied to canary route. Confirming traffic now stable=100% on v2.4.0.
tom: monitoring — errors trending back down. p95 latency returning to baseline.
eva: added a note to release notes draft: "paused staged rollout due to kv-cache timeouts observed in eu region; rollback to v2.4.0 for canary" — link: https://redwood.internal/notes/resp-rollout-1717500000
mike: file an incident/ops ticket for postmortem and to check kv-cache health during warmup. tag infra and runtime teams.
mari: ticket created: INC-2026-0428. pinned release v2.4.1 in registry to prevent auto-redeploys.
deploy-bot: image redwood/response:v2.4.1 set to manual-promotion=true in registry.
mike: good. we'll re-run canary after infra investigation. thanks all. :thumbsup:
